outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Alameda County Office of Education Services Agreement - Immigrant and Newcomer Support - English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement (ELLMA)

enrichment.headline: Adds $71,000 and a year to Restoration Management Company's school cleanup contract
enrichment.summary: The district is adding $71,000 to its agreement with Restoration Management Company for environmental clean-up services that reduce risk at OUSD school sites. The cap rises from $99,000 to $170,000, and the term is extended from June 30, 2026 to June 30, 2027. It is paid from the district's self-insurance fund.

vendor.name: Restoration Management Company (Jon K Takata Corporation)

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Restoration Management Company - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Extends Claremont Partners' health benefits board support for a year at $36,000
enrichment.summary: Claremont Partners, Inc. will keep providing the same employee health benefits communications and secretarial services to the labor-management Health Benefits Governance Board for another year, through June 30, 2027. The cost stays at $36,000 per year, and nothing else in the agreement changes.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Services Agreement - Claremont Partners, Inc. - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Pays $4.3M for excess property and liability coverage plus $888,000 for workers' comp coverage
enrichment.summary: The district will pay two insurance premiums for 2026-27. Northern California ReLiEF, a joint powers authority (JPA), is paid $4,318,365 for excess property and liability coverage for July 1, 2026 through July 1, 2027, through broker Keenan & Associates. The Public Risk Innovation, Solutions, and Management (PRISM) JPA is paid $888,000 for excess workers' compensation coverage.

outcome.action: Adopted

items.title: Excess Workers’ Compensation Coverage and Excess Property and Liability Coverage - Premium Payment - Fiscal Year 2026-2027 - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Hires George Hills Company for liability claims adjusting at up to $400,000 a year
enrichment.summary: George Hills Company, Inc. will adjust the district's liability and property claims for up to $400,000 per fiscal year, with a 3% annual increase, from June 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028. The board chose it after rejecting all other bids, and the district may renew for one-year periods. A separate data sharing agreement covers the data the district sends the company and how it is protected.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Claims Adjusting and Administrative Services Contract, Subrogation Agreement and Data Sharing Agreement - George Hills Company - General Counsel

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $39,700 for the Epicenter platform to track charter school oversight data
enrichment.summary: The Institute for Excellence In Education will provide its Epicenter platform, with setup and technical support, so the Office of Charter Schools can track charter governance, admissions, finances, enrollment, attendance, teacher credentials and other compliance documents. The agreement runs July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.

vendor.name: The Institute for Excellence In Education

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - The Institute for Excellence In Education - Charter Schools Office

enrichment.headline: Pays Centurisk up to $249,500 to verify the district's equipment and fixed assets
enrichment.summary: Centurisk will inspect district sites and verify its inventory of machinery and equipment that cost $500 or more, and give the district the data it needs to account for its capital assets. The work also supports government accounting standards (GASB 34) reporting and the external audit. The term began April 10, 2026, before board approval, and runs through June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The board is ratifying the written minutes of its regular meeting held June 3, 2026, which staff prepared shortly after the meeting. No money is involved.
